policy.rule: No matched KEEP path is publishable until public-candidate verification passes. PRIVATE paths are excluded by default. REVIEW paths fail closed until individually dispositioned.

rationale..agents/: agent prompts may encode operational/strategy assumptions; reintroduce only after public-safe review
rationale..claude/: agent commands may encode operational/strategy assumptions; reintroduce only after public-safe review
rationale.data/: research/runtime/evidence datasets are private by default
rationale.deploy/: deployment topology and service configuration are private by default
rationale.docs/: historical audit, handoff, runtime, strategy, and operational documentation is private by default
rationale.ops/: operational and box-management tooling is private by default
rationale.research/: strategy research and evidence are private by default
rationale.scripts/: mixed research/ops/admin tooling; selectively reintroduce only after review
rationale.site/: current site tree contains deployment topology, internal paths, host/routing details, and operational security assumptions; exclude from clean export until separately sanitized
rationale.tests/fixtures/: fixtures include operator-exported and market/research datasets; exclude by default rather than republish source data
rationale.CHANGELOG.md: historical operational and strategy details; clean export should start with a public changelog
rationale.RUNBOOK.md: operator/runtime procedures require a public-safe rewrite
rationale.risk_rules.yaml: contains current strategy/risk policy and evidence commentary; private strategy material by policy
rationale.config/settings.py: contains extensive current deployment/research policy and historical evidence commentary; requires a public-safe configuration boundary before inclusion
rationale.config/cross_instrument_observation.json: active research campaign design and detector inventory
rationale.config/forward_evidence_campaign.json: active forward-evidence campaign design and experiment parameters

publication_gates: apply public-safe overrides for remaining REVIEW exact files
run secret scan on exported tree
run public-operational-detail scan on exported tree
run tests against candidate and document missing private-only dependencies
verify no private/runtime evidence was copied
create new repository from candidate tree with no inherited refs/history
configure rulesets/branch protection before normal development

notes: GitHub CI uses read-only contents permission and no repository secrets.
Notification routes contain environment-variable names only, not destination URLs.
Futures contract metadata is sourced public contract-unit information and grants no execution eligibility.
Course content is paper/simulation oriented and does not require broker credentials.

Current site README exposes nginx web-root, host routing, localhost ports, webhook path/auth design, and internal audit references; site is therefore excluded wholesale pending a separate sanitized public-site export.
C14 fixture documentation identifies operator TradingView exports copied verbatim; all fixtures remain excluded by default.
